title: Salsamukk
description: Salsamukk is the ultimate Minecraft hub for grinding a permanent economy or crushing 1.21.11 duels on the practice server. Join a powerhouse community on any modern version via salsamukk.in. Optimized for both Java and Bedrock players to play together.
body:
![salsamukk banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79b764b17725636630bfe0d8fad36d8ba6375f83.webp)Salsamukk Network!

Salsamukk is the ultimate destination for Minecraft players who love the thrill of the grind and the intensity of competitive combat. We provide a high-performance, lag-free environment designed to give you the best multiplayer experience possible.

💰 Permanent Economy Survival
Tired of losing your progress to seasonal resets? Our Permanent Economy server is built for the long haul.

Infinite Grinding: Work your way to the top of the leaderboards by gathering rare loot and building your empire.

Player-Driven Market: Trade, sell, and auction items to become the wealthiest player on the server.

No Resets: Your builds and your bank balance are safe here—forever.

🏹 Elite Practice Server (1.20 - 1.21.11+)
Sharpen your skills in our dedicated Practice arena, fully optimized for all modern versions up to 1.21.11.

Modern Combat: Master the latest mechanics, including Crystal PvP, Anchor combat, and specialized KitPvP.

Smooth Performance: Low-ping infrastructure ensures your hits land exactly when they should.

Multiple Gamemodes: From Duels to Bedwars practice, we have everything you need to become a PvP god.

🌐 Seamless Connectivity
We believe everyone should play together, regardless of their device.

Java & Bedrock Cross-Play: Join from your PC, console, or mobile phone without any issues.

Universal IP: Just use salsamukk.in to jump straight into the action!

🛠️ Always Evolving
We are constantly developing new features, custom plugins, and gameplay tweaks to keep things fresh. Our dev team is always working behind the scenes to make Salsamukk even better!

💡 Have an Idea?
We value our community above all else. If you have a feature you’d love to see or a gamemode you think we’re missing, feel free to suggest it! Your feedback helps shape the future of the network.

Join us today and start your journey!
📍 IP: salsamukk.in
🎮 Version: 1.20 - 1.21.11+
